description: Control the systemd machine manager and its containers and images.

next.name: bind
tip: Bind mount a host file or directory into a machine.

next.name: cat
tip: Show the settings file of machines.

next.name: clean
tip: Remove hidden container or VM images.

next.name: clone
tip: Clone a container or VM image.

next.name: copy-from
tip: Copy files from a machine into the host.

next.name: copy-to
tip: Copy files from the host into a machine.

next.name: disable
tip: Disable container images from starting at boot.

next.name: edit
tip: Edit the settings file of machines.

next.name: enable
tip: Enable container images to start at boot.

next.name: image-status
tip: Show terse status information about images.

next.name: kill
tip: Send a signal to processes of machines.

next.name: list
tip: List currently running virtual machines and containers.

next.name: list-images
tip: List locally installed container and VM images.

next.name: login
tip: Open an interactive terminal login session.

next.name: poweroff
tip: Power off machines cleanly.
stop is an alias for poweroff.

next.name: read-only
tip: Mark or unmark an image read-only.

next.name: remove
tip: Remove container or VM images.

next.name: rename
tip: Rename a container or VM image.

next.name: restart
tip: Reboot machines.
restart is an alias for reboot.

next.name: set-limit
tip: Set the maximum size an image may grow to.

next.name: shell
tip: Open an interactive shell session or run a command.

next.name: show
tip: Show properties of machines or the manager.

next.name: show-image
tip: Show properties of images or the manager.

next.name: start
tip: Start container images as system services.

next.name: status
tip: Show runtime status information about machines.

next.name: terminate
tip: Immediately terminate machines.

option.name: --all
tip: Show all properties and hidden images.

option.name: --force
tip: Replace the target file when copying files.

option.name: --full
tip: Do not ellipsize output.
Implies --max-addresses=full.

option.name: --help
tip: Show this help.

option.name: --host
tip: Operate on a remote host.

option.name: --kill-whom
tip: Choose which processes to kill.
Possible values: leader, all

option.name: --lines
tip: Number of journal lines shown by status.

option.name: --machine
tip: Connect to the machine manager in a local container.

option.name: --max-addresses
tip: Limit the number of IP addresses shown per machine.
Use all to request every address.

option.name: --mkdir
tip: Create the destination before applying a bind mount.

option.name: --no-ask-password
tip: Do not ask for system passwords.

option.name: --no-legend
tip: Do not show the headers and footers.

option.name: --no-pager
tip: Do not pipe output into a pager.

option.name: --now
tip: Start or power off containers together with enable or disable.

option.name: --output
tip: Formatting of journal entries shown by status.
See journalctl(1) for the available choices.

option.name: --property
tip: Limit the output to the specified properties.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Suppress additional informational output.

option.name: --read-only
tip: Create a read-only bind mount or image clone.

option.name: --runner
tip: Choose the machine runner.
Possible values: nspawn, vmspawn

option.name: --setenv
tip: Set an environment variable for the executed shell.
May be used more than once.

option.name: --signal
tip: Select the signal to send.

option.name: --uid
tip: Choose the user ID to open a shell session as.

option.name: --value
tip: Only print the property value.

option.name: --version
tip: Show package version.

option.name: -P
tip: Equivalent to --value --property=NAME.

option.name: -V
tip: Shorthand for --runner=vmspawn.
